title: Machine learning selects cuproptosis-related genes for keloid diagnosis
summary: SVM, random forest, GLM and XGBoost models trained on two GEO datasets selected 10 cuproptosis-related genes for keloid diagnosis from 110 WGCNA candidates. Diagnostic capability was checked in three independent GEO datasets and by RT-qPCR, Western blotting and immunohistochemistry on keloid tissue. The abstract gives no AUC or sample sizes, and mechanism claims such as MAPK involvement are not verified.
